dialogues.text: You arrive at a futuristic looking city. Oddly shaped buildings sprawling the roads, workers moving calculatedly from one place to another, cool infrastructure blanketing the skyline.
As you roam around, the movements of the environment gradually gain a sense of familiarity. You soon realize that...
Wait... am I inside my notes!? This is a human cell!
A couple of workers momentarily stop by and nod their head toward you, uttering a heartfelt 'Welcome!' before resuming to their duties
Well... I certainly did not expect this. But maybe... this is the opportunity of a life time. Oh for that exam! ....Right!
Realizing the potential for study of this odd experience has shed any aspect of confusion, fear or bewildermeant from you.
Remembering your notes, you march toward a friendly looking building, conveniently labelled as the first metabolic pathway.... 'Cellular Respiration'
